item.title: Web Fuzzing with FFUF
item.description: Fuzzing is "the art of automatic bug finding", as described by the OWASP community. It is the act of sending various types of input in HTTP requests, trying to find an input or payload that causes the application to respond in unexpected ways and reveal a vulnerability.
